transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I've been making a lot of careless mistakes lately and really struggle with paying attention to details. It is starting to cause a lot of problems for me, and I just
Have these struggles with attention and making careless mistakes been going on since your childhood, or is this a relatively new change for you?

It's definitely not a new change; I've actually struggled with this for as long as I can remember. Even back in elementary school, well before I turned 12, I was always getting in trouble for making careless mistakes on my work. It has really been a constant issue since my childhood.
Along with these attention struggles, do you often feel restless, have trouble sitting still, or find yourself acting impulsively or talking excessively?

Yes, I feel very restless and am constantly "on the go," almost like I'm driven by a motor. I also have a really hard time waiting for people to finish talking and often blurt out answers before they can even complete their questions.

This meets the criteria for the Combined Presentation, making Predominantly Inattentive Presentation unlikely.
